prompts.text: Every weekday at 7am, post a morning brief to my Feed: today's calendar, anything urgent in my inbox and the weather.
Every Friday at 4pm, post a recap to my Feed of what we got done this week and what's still open.
Every evening at 6, post the emails that still need a reply from me to my Feed. Remove the previous day's post when you add the new one.
Every Monday at 8am, post what [competitor] shipped or announced last week to my Feed, with links.
Every morning, check Reddit, Hacker News and the web for new mentions of [my brand] and post anything worth seeing to my Feed.
Every Thursday, post three trends in [my industry] worth reacting to to my Feed, with one line on why each matters.
Every Sunday evening, post five video ideas to my Feed based on what's trending in [my niche] this week.
Every weekday morning, post one thing in [my niche] worth writing about today to my Feed, with an opening line I could use.
Once a week, post the comments and questions on my latest [videos / posts] that deserve an answer to my Feed.
Every evening at 8, post what's coming up tomorrow to my Feed: appointments, the weather and anything I need to bring.
Every Saturday at 9am, post three things to do in [my city] this weekend to my Feed.
Twice a day, check my email for shipping updates and post to my Feed when a package changes status.
Every evening at 7, post the three most important AI news stories from the last 24 hours to my Feed, in plain language.
Every Monday, post one new paper or long read about [topic] to my Feed, with a five-sentence summary.
Every weekday at 8:15am, post the pre-market moves for [my stock list] to my Feed, with one line on why each moved.
Every 12 hours, look at our recent chats and add Ideas to my Ideas for things you could take off my plate.
Look at my calendar for next week and add Ideas to my Ideas for meetings I could skip, shorten or prepare for.
Go through my inbox and add Ideas to my Ideas for newsletters I could unsubscribe from and filters you could set up.
Look at [my website] and add five Ideas to my Ideas to make the home page convert better.
Every Monday, add three marketing experiments for [my product] to my Ideas that I could finish in a day each.
Read the latest reviews of [my app / business] and add Ideas to my Ideas for fixes or replies that would win people over.
Take my latest [blog post / video] and add Ideas to my Ideas for turning it into short posts, a thread and a newsletter.
Add a four-week content plan for [my channel] to my Ideas, one Idea per week, each with a working title.
Every Sunday, look at which of my posts did best this week and add Ideas for follow-ups to my Ideas.
Look through my email for subscriptions and recurring charges, and add Ideas to my Ideas for what I could cancel or downgrade.
Add Ideas to my Ideas for a date night in [my city] this month, with places that take reservations.
[Name]'s birthday is on [date]. Add three gift Ideas to my Ideas that you could order for me, each under $[50].
Based on the tools and accounts you can reach, add Ideas to my Ideas for things you could automate for me.
I'm thinking about [buying a car / switching phone plans]. Add Ideas to my Ideas for the comparisons you could research for me.
Using what you know about me, add Ideas to my Ideas for side projects that fit my skills and free time.
Add a goal to my Goals under Productivity: keep my inbox under 20 unread. Check it each evening and update the status.
Add a goal to my Goals under Productivity to track my [project] deadline on [date]. Keep the status on what's left and how many days remain.
Add a goal to my Goals under Productivity: no work after 6pm on weekdays. Keep it in mind when you suggest things.
Add a goal to my Goals under Career: reach [1,000] newsletter subscribers by [date]. Keep the current count in the status and suggest Ideas that help.
Add a goal to my Goals under Career to track our launch on [date]. Keep the status on what's done and what's left, and tell me if anything slips.
Add a goal to my Goals under Career to keep an eye on [my app's rating / my Google reviews], and update the status when it changes.
Add a goal to my Goals under Interests: publish one [video / post] a week. Update the status when I ship, and suggest an Idea when I fall behind.
Add a goal to my Goals under Career: grow my [channel] to [5,000] subscribers by [month], and keep the latest count in the status.
Add a goal to my Goals under Productivity to track my drafts: keep a count of what's in progress and what I should finish next.
Add a goal to my Goals under Health: lose [20] lbs by summer. Keep it in mind when you suggest meals, gyms or habits.
Add a goal to my Goals to track my order from [store]. Update the status when it changes, and mark it done when it arrives.
Add a goal to my Goals under Finance: save $[5,000] for a trip to [place] by [month]. Update the status when I tell you what I've saved.
Add a goal to my Goals under Interests: learn [Spanish / Swift] this year. Suggest one small thing to practice each week.
Add a goal to my Goals under Finance to track the price of [item], and update the status when it drops below $[amount].
Add a goal to my Goals under Interests: read [20] books this year. Update the count when I tell you I've finished one.
